mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.directory_source(id, source, environment, source_tenant_ref, tenant_id, issuer) VALUES (#{id}, #{source}, #{environment}, #{sourceTenantRef}, #{tenantId}, #{issuer}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, source, environment, source_tenant_ref, tenant_id, issuer, last_sequence, last_fingerprint, quarantined FROM auth_governance.directory_source WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM auth_governance.tenant WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR SHARE
SELECT id, kind, status, version FROM auth_governance.principal WHERE id = #{id} AND kind = 'HUMAN' FOR SHARE
SELECT FROM auth_governance.directory_inbox WHERE source_id = #{source} AND event_id = #{event}
SELECT FROM auth_governance.directory_inbox WHERE source_id = #{source} AND partition_sequence = #{sequence}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.directory_inbox(source_id, event_id, partition_sequence, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, payload_hash, fingerprint, snapshot_id, processed) VALUES (#{source}, #{event.eventId}, #{event.partitionSequence}, #{event.aggregateType}, #{event.aggregateId}, #{event.aggregateVersion}, #{event.payloadHash}, #{fingerprint}, #{event.snapshotId}, #{processed})
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash FROM auth_governance.directory_version_receipt WHERE source_id = #{source} AND aggregate_type = #{type} AND aggregate_id = #{id} AND aggregate_version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.directory_version_receipt(source_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, payload_hash) VALUES (#{source}, #{event.aggregateType}, #{event.aggregateId}, #{event.aggregateVersion}, #{event.payloadHash})
mapper.select: SELECT aggregate_id FROM auth_governance.directory_entry WHERE source_id = #{source} AND membership_id = #{member}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.directory_entry(source_id, tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, payload_hash, payload_json, principal_id, membership_id, login_subject) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{tenantId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{aggregateVersion}, #{payloadHash}, CAST(#{payloadJson} AS jsonb), #{principalId}, #{membershipId}, #{loginSubject}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id) DO UPDATE SET aggregate_version = EXCLUDED.aggregate_version, payload_hash = EXCLUDED.payload_hash, payload_json = EXCLUDED.payload_json, principal_id = EXCLUDED.principal_id, membership_id = EXCLUDED.membership_id, login_subject = EXCLUDED.login_subject, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE auth_governance.directory_entry.aggregate_version < EXCLUDED.aggregate_version

INSERT INTO auth_governance.directory_change_evidence(source_id,event_id,tenant_id,partition_sequence,aggregate_type,aggregate_id,aggregate_version,event_fingerprint,membership_id,outcome,before_json,after_json,occurred_at) VALUES(#{sourceId},#{eventId},#{tenantId},#{partitionSequence},#{aggregateType},#{aggregateId},#{aggregateVersion},#{eventFingerprint},#{membershipId},#{outcome},CAST(#{beforeJson} AS jsonb),CAST(#{afterJson} AS jsonb),CAST(#{occurredAt} AS timestamptz))
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.membership SET status = #{after}, version = version + 1, generation = generation + CASE WHEN #{rejoin} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, valid_from = CASE WHEN #{rejoin} THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE valid_from END, valid_to = CASE WHEN #{rejoin} THEN NULL ELSE valid_to END, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{member} AND tenant_id = #{tenant} AND member_kind = 'EMPLOYEE' AND version = #{version} AND status = #{before} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','LEFT')
mapper.select: SELECT source_id, snapshot_id, start_sequence, end_sequence, expected_count, content_hash, begin_seen, end_seen, complete FROM auth_governance.directory_snapshot WHERE source_id = #{source} AND snapshot_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.directory_snapshot(source_id, snapshot_id, start_sequence, end_sequence, expected_count, content_hash, begin_seen, end_seen) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{snapshotId}, #{startSequence}, #{endSequence}, #{expectedCount}, #{contentHash}, #{beginSeen}, #{endSeen})
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.directory_snapshot SET begin_seen = begin_seen OR #{begin}, end_seen = end_seen OR NOT #{begin} WHERE source_id = #{source} AND snapshot_id = #{id}
UPDATE auth_governance.directory_snapshot SET complete = true WHERE source_id = #{source} AND snapshot_id = #{id} AND begin_seen AND end_seen AND NOT complete
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_governance.directory_inbox WHERE source_id = #{source} AND partition_sequence > #{after} ORDER BY partition_sequence LIMIT 20001
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.directory_source SET last_sequence = #{after}, last_fingerprint = #{fingerprint} WHERE id = #{source} AND last_sequence = #{before} AND NOT quarantined
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.directory_conflict(source_id, event_id, fingerprint, reason) VALUES (#{source}, #{event}, #{fingerprint}, #{reason}) ON CONFLICT (source_id, event_id, fingerprint, reason) DO UPDATE SET last_seen = clock_timestamp(), occurrences = auth_governance.directory_conflict.occurrences + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.directory_source SET quarantined = true WHERE id = #{source}
UPDATE auth_governance.directory_source SET business_zone=#{zone} WHERE id=#{source} AND NOT quarantined
